entries.text: Linux x64 AppImage releases are available alongside Debian packages. After allowing update access, you can download an AppImage update and choose Restart and update to apply it.
After the first-run quick start, desktop users are asked whether Warplyn may check GitHub for updates. You can allow access or dismiss the request.
The Utility Area update control can download an available update or restart to apply a ready update without first opening About Settings.
Windows update details explain that downloading also approves installation on the next launch, and the ready status reminds you when it will apply.
About Settings marks releases identified as security updates with a Security update badge.
A verified AppImage update already downloaded was not restored as ready after checking releases again; it is now recognized, and restarting an installed AppImage launches the replacement.
The desktop window could remain hidden after its first renderer load; it now appears once that load completes.
